ZSV_ACDOCA_NET.@DataWarehouse.sqlEditor.query:
SELECT
  A.MONTH,
  A.YEAR,
  A.CALMONTH,
  A.QUARTER,
  A.CALWEEK,
  A.DATE_SAP,
  A.DAY_OF_WEEK,
  A.DAY_INT,
 
  B.CompanyCode,
  B.CompanyCodeText,
  B.FiscalYear,
  B.GLAccount,
  B.ChartOfAccounts,
  B.ControllingArea,
  B.FunctionalArea,
  B.BusinessArea,
  B.CompanyCodeCurrency,
  B.GLAccountType,
  B.ProfitCenter,
  B.CostCenter,
  B.FiscalPeriod,
  B.PostingDate,
 
  B.AncestorLevel1Value,
  B.AncestorLevel2Value,
  B.AncestorLevel3Value,
  B.AncestorLevel4Value,
  B.AncestorLevel5Value,
 
  -- ═══════════════════════════════════════════
  -- ORIGINAL 6 MEASURES — raw amount, untouched
  -- ═══════════════════════════════════════════
 
  SUM(CASE
    WHEN B.FiscalYear = :P_YEAR
     AND B.PostingDate >= TO_DATE(:P_YEAR || TO_VARCHAR(CURRENT_DATE,'MM') || '01','YYYYMMDD')
     AND B.PostingDate <= ADD_YEARS(CURRENT_DATE, CAST(:P_YEAR AS INTEGER) - YEAR(CURRENT_DATE))
    THEN B.Amount ELSE 0
  END) AS MTD_CURRENT_YEAR,
 
  SUM(CASE
    WHEN B.FiscalYear = :P_YEAR
     AND B.PostingDate >= TO_DATE(:P_YEAR || '0101','YYYYMMDD')
     AND B.PostingDate <= ADD_YEARS(CURRENT_DATE, CAST(:P_YEAR AS INTEGER) - YEAR(CURRENT_DATE))
    THEN B.Amount ELSE 0
  END) AS YTD_CURRENT_YEAR,
 
  SUM(CASE WHEN B.FiscalYear = :P_YEAR
    THEN B.Amount ELSE 0 END
  ) AS COMPLETED_CURRENT_YTD,
 
  SUM(CASE WHEN B.FiscalYear = CAST(CAST(:P_YEAR AS INTEGER)-1 AS NVARCHAR)
    THEN B.Amount ELSE 0 END
  ) AS PREVIOUS_YEAR_COMPLETED,
 
  SUM(CASE
    WHEN B.FiscalYear = CAST(CAST(:P_YEAR AS INTEGER)-1 AS NVARCHAR)
     AND B.PostingDate >= TO_DATE(CAST(CAST(:P_YEAR AS INTEGER)-1 AS NVARCHAR) || '0101','YYYYMMDD')
     AND B.PostingDate <= ADD_YEARS(CURRENT_DATE, CAST(CAST(:P_YEAR AS INTEGER)-1 AS INTEGER) - YEAR(CURRENT_DATE))
    THEN B.Amount ELSE 0
  END) AS PREVIOUS_YEAR_YTD,
 
  SUM(CASE
    WHEN B.FiscalYear = CAST(CAST(:P_YEAR AS INTEGER)-1 AS NVARCHAR)
     AND B.PostingDate >= TO_DATE(CAST(CAST(:P_YEAR AS INTEGER)-1 AS NVARCHAR) || TO_VARCHAR(CURRENT_DATE,'MM') || '01','YYYYMMDD')
     AND B.PostingDate <= ADD_YEARS(CURRENT_DATE, CAST(CAST(:P_YEAR AS INTEGER)-1 AS INTEGER) - YEAR(CURRENT_DATE))
    THEN B.Amount ELSE 0
  END) AS PREVIOUS_YEAR_MTD,
 
  -- ═══════════════════════════════════════════
  -- NEW 6 MEASURES — sign-adjusted
  -- Checks ALL 10 ancestor levels for '0ASSETS'
  -- ═══════════════════════════════════════════
 
  SUM(CASE
    WHEN B.FiscalYear = :P_YEAR
     AND B.PostingDate >= TO_DATE(:P_YEAR || TO_VARCHAR(CURRENT_DATE,'MM') || '01','YYYYMMDD')
     AND B.PostingDate <= ADD_YEARS(CURRENT_DATE, CAST(:P_YEAR AS INTEGER) - YEAR(CURRENT_DATE))
    THEN B.AmountSign ELSE 0
  END) AS MTD_CURRENT_YEAR_SIGN,
 
  SUM(CASE
    WHEN B.FiscalYear = :P_YEAR
     AND B.PostingDate >= TO_DATE(:P_YEAR || '0101','YYYYMMDD')
     AND B.PostingDate <= ADD_YEARS(CURRENT_DATE, CAST(:P_YEAR AS INTEGER) - YEAR(CURRENT_DATE))
    THEN B.AmountSign ELSE 0
  END) AS YTD_CURRENT_YEAR_SIGN,
 
  SUM(CASE WHEN B.FiscalYear = :P_YEAR
    THEN B.AmountSign ELSE 0 END
  ) AS COMPLETED_CURRENT_YTD_SIGN,
 
  SUM(CASE WHEN B.FiscalYear = CAST(CAST(:P_YEAR AS INTEGER)-1 AS NVARCHAR)
    THEN B.AmountSign ELSE 0 END
  ) AS PREVIOUS_YEAR_COMPLETED_SIGN,
 
  SUM(CASE
    WHEN B.FiscalYear = CAST(CAST(:P_YEAR AS INTEGER)-1 AS NVARCHAR)
     AND B.PostingDate >= TO_DATE(CAST(CAST(:P_YEAR AS INTEGER)-1 AS NVARCHAR) || '0101','YYYYMMDD')
     AND B.PostingDate <= ADD_YEARS(CURRENT_DATE, CAST(CAST(:P_YEAR AS INTEGER)-1 AS INTEGER) - YEAR(CURRENT_DATE))
    THEN B.AmountSign ELSE 0
  END) AS PREVIOUS_YEAR_YTD_SIGN,
 
  SUM(CASE
    WHEN B.FiscalYear = CAST(CAST(:P_YEAR AS INTEGER)-1 AS NVARCHAR)
     AND B.PostingDate >= TO_DATE(CAST(CAST(:P_YEAR AS INTEGER)-1 AS NVARCHAR) || TO_VARCHAR(CURRENT_DATE,'MM') || '01','YYYYMMDD')
     AND B.PostingDate <= ADD_YEARS(CURRENT_DATE, CAST(CAST(:P_YEAR AS INTEGER)-1 AS INTEGER) - YEAR(CURRENT_DATE))
    THEN B.AmountSign ELSE 0
  END) AS PREVIOUS_YEAR_MTD_SIGN
 
FROM (
  SELECT
    BASE.rbukrs                     AS CompanyCode,
    COALESCE(CC.butxt, BASE.rbukrs) AS CompanyCodeText,
    BASE.gjahr                      AS FiscalYear,
    BASE.racct                      AS GLAccount,
    BASE.ktopl                      AS ChartOfAccounts,
    BASE.kokrs                      AS ControllingArea,
    BASE.rfarea                     AS FunctionalArea,
    BASE.rbusa                      AS BusinessArea,
    BASE.rhcur                      AS CompanyCodeCurrency,
    BASE.glaccount_type             AS GLAccountType,
    BASE.prctr                      AS ProfitCenter,
    BASE.rcntr                      AS CostCenter,
    CAST(BASE.budat AS DATE)        AS PostingDate,
    CASE
      WHEN BASE.poper = '000' THEN '001'
      WHEN BASE.poper >= '013' THEN '012'
      ELSE BASE.poper
    END                             AS FiscalPeriod,
 
    H.AncestorLevel1Value           AS AncestorLevel1Value,
    H.AncestorLevel2Value           AS AncestorLevel2Value,
    H.AncestorLevel3Value           AS AncestorLevel3Value,
    H.AncestorLevel4Value           AS AncestorLevel4Value,
    H.AncestorLevel5Value           AS AncestorLevel5Value,
 
    SUM(BASE.hsl)                   AS Amount,
 
    -- *** DEFINITIVE FIX: check ALL ancestor levels for '0ASSETS' ***
    -- Works regardless of how deep the GL account sits in the hierarchy
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN H.AncestorLevel1Value  = '0ASSETS'
          OR H.AncestorLevel2Value  = '0ASSETS'
          OR H.AncestorLevel3Value  = '0ASSETS'
          OR H.AncestorLevel4Value  = '0ASSETS'
          OR H.AncestorLevel5Value  = '0ASSETS'
          OR H.AncestorLevel6Value  = '0ASSETS'
          OR H.AncestorLevel7Value  = '0ASSETS'
          OR H.AncestorLevel8Value  = '0ASSETS'
          OR H.AncestorLevel9Value  = '0ASSETS'
          OR H.AncestorLevel10Value = '0ASSETS'
        THEN BASE.hsl
        ELSE BASE.hsl * -1
      END
    )                               AS AmountSign
 
  FROM "ACDOCA_VIEW" AS BASE
 
  LEFT OUTER JOIN "RAD_S3P.ZI_T001" AS CC
    ON BASE.rbukrs = CC.bukrs
 
  LEFT OUTER JOIN "RAD_S3P.ZI_GLACCT_FLAT_BASE" AS H
    ON BASE.racct = H.GLAccount
 
  WHERE BASE.gjahr IN (
    :P_YEAR,
    CAST(CAST(:P_YEAR AS INTEGER) - 1 AS NVARCHAR)
  )
 
  GROUP BY
    BASE.rbukrs,
    COALESCE(CC.butxt, BASE.rbukrs),
    BASE.gjahr,
    BASE.racct,
    BASE.ktopl,
    BASE.kokrs,
    BASE.rfarea,
    BASE.rbusa,
    BASE.rhcur,
    BASE.glaccount_type,
    BASE.prctr,
    BASE.rcntr,
    BASE.budat,
    BASE.poper,
    H.AncestorLevel1Value,
    H.AncestorLevel2Value,
    H.AncestorLevel3Value,
    H.AncestorLevel4Value,
    H.AncestorLevel5Value
 
) AS B
 
LEFT OUTER JOIN "S4ONPREM.SAP.TIME.VIEW_DIMENSION_DAY" AS A
  ON A.DATE_SAP = B.PostingDate
 
WHERE A.YEAR IN (
  :P_YEAR,
  CAST(CAST(:P_YEAR AS INTEGER) - 1 AS NVARCHAR)
)
 
GROUP BY
  A.MONTH, A.YEAR, A.CALMONTH, A.QUARTER, A.CALWEEK,
  A.DATE_SAP, A.DAY_OF_WEEK, A.DAY_INT,
  B.CompanyCode, B.CompanyCodeText, B.FiscalYear, B.GLAccount,
  B.ChartOfAccounts, B.ControllingArea, B.FunctionalArea, B.BusinessArea,
  B.CompanyCodeCurrency, B.GLAccountType, B.ProfitCenter, B.CostCenter,
  B.PostingDate, B.FiscalPeriod,
  B.AncestorLevel1Value, B.AncestorLevel2Value, B.AncestorLevel3Value,
  B.AncestorLevel4Value, B.AncestorLevel5Value;
